04 / THE PROCESS

Curiosity, with
a practical direction.

The questions I bring to a project—
from the first idea to a usable interface.

01

Understand the problem.

Who is this for? What decision or task should become easier? Start with the workflow and the data available.

02

Make the method clear.

Choose a useful baseline. Understand the assumptions. Keep model behavior and application logic explainable.

03

Build, check, improve.

Bring the idea into an interface. Inspect the outputs, document limitations, and make the next improvement specific.

I’m a data science student who enjoys the space between understanding a model and building something people can use.

My interests span machine learning, federated learning, computer vision, statistical reasoning, and generative AI. I work across Python, web development, and desktop applications to turn that learning into projects.

I’m continuing to develop my understanding of evaluation, deployment, and reliable systems. These projects show both what I’ve built and the questions I’m still working through.
